dict.string: Pergola shows your upcoming events from Calendar, including Google calendars you've added to your Mac.
Pergola listens to your music app's audio only while it is playing, to draw the live waveform. It stops within two seconds of pausing and never records other apps.

Pergola reads what's playing in Music or Spotify and sends play, pause and skip commands to it. While your browser is using the microphone, it also checks whether a tab is on a call site such as Google Meet, to show the call's length.
Pergola shows your AirPods and other Bluetooth devices, with their battery levels, when they connect.
Pergola uses your approximate location to show local weather.
